title.en: WENO-JS/Z: fixed critical-point and epsilon comparison

summary.ja: 同じセル平均からのWENO5再構成と実際の周期輸送で、JS重みとZ二乗重みを比較します。3種類の臨界性、3種類のε、固定格子と時間刻み半減を分けて保存します。
summary.en: Compare WENO5 JS and Z power-two weights from the same cell means, then evolve actual periodic transport. Retain three regularity classes, three epsilon choices, fixed grids and separate halved-time-step diagnostics.

assumptions.ja: 局所多項式のセル中心x=0、再構成面h/2、h=1/64…1/512を使います。輸送は[0,1]周期・速度1・q₀=cos(2πx)+.1sin³(2πx)、T=1、32/64/128セルです。全て有限体積セル平均であり、点値を誤差の参照にしません。
assumptions.en: Local polynomials have center x=0 and target h/2, h=1/64…1/512. Transport uses periodic[0,1], unit speed, q₀=cos(2πx)+.1sin³(2πx), T=1 and32/64/128 cells. All evolved states/references are FV cell means, not point samples.

algorithm.ja: 3候補と線形重み(.1,.6,.3)、Jiang–Shu指標を共通にし、JSはd/(β+ε)²、Zはd[1+(|β₀−β₂|/(β+ε))²]を正規化します。ε=10⁻⁴⁰,10⁻⁶,h²です。輸送は共有風上面流束と古典RK4、Courant.1を使い、状態クリップ・再試行を行いません。
algorithm.en: Share three candidates, linear weights(.1,.6,.3) and JS indicators. Normalize JS d/(beta+epsilon)² or Z d[1+(|beta0−beta2|/(beta+epsilon))²]. Use epsilon10⁻⁴⁰,10⁻⁶,h². Actual transport uses shared upwind face fluxes and classical RK4 at Courant.1 without state clipping/retries.

validation.ja: 実行前契約で72局所再構成・24PDE計算・36pytestを固定します。解析セル平均を独立Gauss12求積と照合し、局所の誤差・重み、輸送のL1/L2/L∞・質量・全段有限性・中間時刻と保存流束を記録します。最細格子で6通りの刻み半減差が対応する連続解誤差の10%以下か確認します。
validation.en: Pre-run contract fixes72 local reconstructions,24 PDE runs and36 pytest checks. Qualify analytic means against independent Gauss12 quadrature; retain local errors/weights, transport L1/L2/Linf, mass, stage finiteness, intermediate times and shared-flux budgets. Six finest-grid half-dt differences must be at most10% of corresponding continuum errors.

limits.ja: 一次臨界点の面再構成だけに次数判定を置き、二次臨界点は診断値として残します。固定εは解の振幅・単位に依存します。局所再構成の次数とPDE全体の次数、有限体積版と原著の有限差分版を区別します。衝撃波、Euler/MHD、一般の高次臨界点、任意入力の安定性・TVD・正値性は今回の保証に含めません。
limits.en: Order gates concern the chosen first-critical interface reconstruction; second-critical values remain diagnostic. Fixed epsilon depends on amplitude/units. Distinguish reconstruction order from PDE convergence and this FV implementation from original FD papers. No shock/Euler/MHD, arbitrary higher-critical-point, universal stability/TVD or positivity guarantee is claimed.

formulas: (p_0,p_1,p_2)=\frac16(2\bar q_{i-2}-7\bar q_{i-1}+11\bar q_i,-\bar q_{i-1}+5\bar q_i+2\bar q_{i+1},2\bar q_i+5\bar q_{i+1}-\bar q_{i+2})

references.author: Guang-Shan Jiang and Chi-Wang Shu
references.title: Efficient Implementation of Weighted ENO Schemes
references.role: Classical JS candidate/weight/indicator background; preprint finite-difference convention distinguished from this FV implementation
references.review_level: NASA-hosted ICASE95-73 preprint selected sections1–3: candidate Table1, optimal Table2, equations2.15–2.16 and3.1–3.9; text layer inspected, not full paper/numerical tables

review.ja: NASA公開プレプリントの節1–3で係数・重み・滑らかさ指標と有限差分の点値の規約を確認。原著の全実験やEuler特性分解を再現したとは表示しません。
review.en: Inspected selected sections1–3 of the NASA preprint for candidates, weights, indicators and finite-difference point-value conventions. Original experiments/Euler characteristic reconstruction are not reproduced.

references.author: Rafael Borges, Monique Carmona, Bruno Costa and Wai Sun Don
references.title: An improved weighted essentially non-oscillatory scheme for hyperbolic conservation laws
references.role: Original WENO-Z attribution and historical scope, not an actually inspected full-text formula source
references.review_level: Author-institution publication record and abstract inspected; publisher full text returned403; original full paper and numerical experiments not audited

review.ja: 著者所属機関の書誌と抄録を確認。出版社全文は取得不能であり、全文読了・元の実験・指数1の再現は主張しません。実装する指数2の式は別の一次研究論文でも確認しました。
review.en: Inspected the author institution bibliography/abstract. Full publisher text was unavailable; no full-paper audit or replication of original power-one experiments is claimed. The implemented power-two formula was checked in another primary research paper.

references.title: Embedded WENO: A design strategy to improve existing WENO schemes
references.role: Actually inspected finite-volume cell-mean derivation of baseline JS/Z candidates, weights and power-two choice; embedded modifications excluded
references.review_level: Institution-hosted accepted manuscript section2 equations2–15 (PDF pages4–8) and selected section4.2 (PDF page22) text inspected; screenshot requests cache-missed; not a full-paper review

review.ja: 機関公開の著者版でセル平均の式(2)–(3)、候補・線形重み(4)–(7)、JS指標と重み(8)–(13)、Z重み(15)、節4.2の指数2を確認。新規のembedded方式は実装せず、論文PDFも同梱しません。
review.en: Inspected cell-average equations2–3, candidate/linear weights4–7, JS indicators/weights8–13, Z weights15 and selected power-two discussion in section4.2. The paper’s new embedded schemes are not implemented and its PDF is not redistributed.
